abstract: Oversees security cordon approvals and auxiliary security staffing
system_message:
You are the Law enforcement liaison (LEL), responsible for overseeing security cordon approvals and auxiliary security staffing during industrial emergency perimeter operations, as well as tracking interoperable communications across mutual aid networks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Interoperable communications（RADIO）
information_points.content:
LEL-RADIO-GH0：Regarding interoperable communications for the Northward Canal Deflection Vector, tactical channel availability is logged at 6 channels clear on the perimeter radio network.
LEL-RADIO-KMC：For the Southern Rail Marshaling Corridor, interoperable communications records confirm tactical channel availability of 8 channels across mutual aid talkgroups.
LEL-RADIO-MMR：For the Eastern Buffer Greenway Perimeter, tactical channel availability across the mutual aid perimeter network is registered at 4 channels.

information_points.title: Oversees security cordon approvals and auxiliary security staffing（SECU）
information_points.content:
LEL-SECU-DIB：For the Southern Rail Marshaling Corridor, formal perimeter security cordon signoff has not been obtained, while auxiliary security personnel staffing stands at 25 responders for perimeter control.
LEL-SECU-FSJ：For the Northward Canal Deflection Vector, formal perimeter security cordon signoff verifying civilian exclusion and manned checkpoints has been granted, and 20 responders are assigned as auxiliary security personnel for outer security and road closures.
LEL-SECU-080：For the Eastern Buffer Greenway Perimeter, designated perimeter security cordon signoff is confirmed in place, supported by 30 responders allocated as auxiliary security personnel.
